200
Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully canceled the specified WAS findings export job.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters, if your request was improperly formatted, or if
Tenable Web App Scanning could not cancel the WAS findings job.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to cancel WAS findings export jobs.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning could not find the specified WAS findings export job.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
